3. When Admin A clicks icon button named "Verify" inside row with Record Id "101" in the "Tile" administration data grid

5. Then cell named "Verified?" inside row with Record Id "101" in the "Tile" administration data grid contains the success icon with tooltip "Verified"
6. And icon button named "Verify" inside row with Record Id "101" in the "Tile" administration data grid is disabled
